SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: This query adds up the discount amounts on orders with status 'completed' that were placed in 2025 (1 January to 31 December). It rounds the total to 2 decimals. I assumed the status value is spelled exactly 'completed', because the schema doesn't list the allowed values. If it's spelled differently, the query will return nothing. I also chose not to filter on is_revenue, since you asked about completed orders and not about all orders that count as revenue.
